title: Persona-Based UX Research
summary: Simulated user interviews that found real accessibility bugs.
problem: Small sites rarely get user research, so serious UX issues ship unnoticed.
solution: A local research workflow with a custom UX adapter and graph storage organising persona responses and page observations into a prioritised backlog.
result: 42 screenshots, 24 persona responses and 8 one-on-one sessions produced a 9-item backlog — including a critical bug where reduced-motion settings hid 5 core sections.
